tools.name: equity-analytics_financial-ratios
tools.description: Profitability, liquidity, leverage, efficiency and valuation ratios from caller-supplied statements and an optional price. Docs: https://www.brainiac.software/api/equity-analytics/financial-ratios Keywords: statements, price, unit, periods, Compute standard financial ratios, financial ratios, Equity

tools.name: equity-analytics_dcf-valuation
tools.description: Discount explicit free cash flows and a Gordon or exit-multiple terminal value to enterprise and equity value per share, with a discount-rate and growth sensitivity grid. Docs: https://www.brainiac.software/api/equity-analytics/dcf-valuation Keywords: fcf, discountRate, terminal, sharesOutstanding,

tools.name: equity-analytics_wacc-calculate
tools.description: CAPM cost of equity and after-tax cost of debt combined into WACC from supplied equity and debt values. Docs: https://www.brainiac.software/api/equity-analytics/wacc-calculate Keywords: equityValue, debtValue, riskFree, beta, equityRiskPremium, costOfDebt, taxRate, sizePremium, costOfEquity, afterTa

tools.name: equity-analytics_beta-regression
tools.description: Align asset and benchmark closes, compute simple returns at daily, weekly or monthly frequency, and return OLS beta, alpha, R², standard error and optional Blume-adjusted beta. Docs: https://www.brainiac.software/api/equity-analytics/beta-regression Keywords: assetPrices, benchmarkPrices, frequency,

tools.name: equity-analytics_corporate-action-adjust
tools.description: Apply split and cash-dividend factors backwards through a price series (CRSP-style multiplicative dividends) and return adjusted closes, volumes and cumulative factors. Docs: https://www.brainiac.software/api/equity-analytics/corporate-action-adjust Keywords: prices, actions, adjusted, Back-adjust p

tools.name: equity-analytics_total-return-series
tools.description: Compound a total-return index from closes and cash dividends with optional withholding tax, and report price return, total return and CAGR. Docs: https://www.brainiac.software/api/equity-analytics/total-return-series Keywords: prices, dividends, base, withholdingTax, index, priceReturn, totalReturn,

tools.name: equity-analytics_altman-z-score
tools.description: Compute the public manufacturing Z-score, private Z′ or non-manufacturing Z″ with published safe/grey/distress zones from caller-supplied balance-sheet and income items. Docs: https://www.brainiac.software/api/equity-analytics/altman-z-score Keywords: variant, workingCapital, retainedEarnings, ebit,

tools.name: equity-analytics_piotroski-f-score
tools.description: Nine binary profitability, leverage, liquidity and operating-efficiency tests from two years of statements. Docs: https://www.brainiac.software/api/equity-analytics/piotroski-f-score Keywords: current, prior, score, tests, Piotroski F-score (0-9), piotroski f score, Equity Analytics, tests.roaPositi

tools.name: equity-analytics_beneish-m-score
tools.description: Compute DSRI, GMI, AQI, SGI, DEPI, SGAI, LVGI and TATA and the Beneish (1999) M-score with the −1.78 flag threshold. Docs: https://www.brainiac.software/api/equity-analytics/beneish-m-score Keywords: current, prior, flag, threshold, indices, Beneish eight-variable M-score, beneish m score, Equity An

tools.name: equity-analytics_dupont-analysis
tools.description: Decompose ROE into net margin, asset turnover and equity multiplier, and optionally the five-step tax, interest and EBIT-margin path. Docs: https://www.brainiac.software/api/equity-analytics/dupont-analysis Keywords: netIncome, revenue, totalAssets, equity, ebt, ebit, threeStep, fiveStep, Three- and

tools.name: equity-analytics_peer-multiples
tools.description: Summarise peer EV/EBITDA, P/E and related multiples with optional IQR trimming, and imply enterprise, equity and per-share values for a target. Docs: https://www.brainiac.software/api/equity-analytics/peer-multiples Keywords: target, peers, multiples, trimOutliersIqr, stats, implied, Peer multiple s

tools.name: equity-analytics_dividend-metrics
tools.description: Compute trailing yield, payout ratio, FCF coverage and DPS CAGR from a price and a dividends-per-share series. Docs: https://www.brainiac.software/api/equity-analytics/dividend-metrics Keywords: price, dividendsPerShare, eps, fcfPerShare, yield, payoutRatio, fcfCoverage, cagr, Dividend yield, payout

tools.name: equity-analytics_security-identifier-validate
tools.description: Detect identifier type by pattern, validate check digits, and optionally convert CUSIP or SEDOL to ISIN. Docs: https://www.brainiac.software/api/equity-analytics/security-identifier-validate Keywords: identifiers, toIsin, results, Validate ISIN, CUSIP and SEDOL check digits, security identifier vali

tools.name: equity-analytics_lei-validate
tools.description: Check ISO 17442 structure and ISO/IEC 7064 MOD 97-10 check digits for a Legal Entity Identifier. Docs: https://www.brainiac.software/api/equity-analytics/lei-validate Keywords: lei, valid, louPrefix, checkDigits, Validate an LEI check digits, lei validate, Equity Analytics, sources.source.
